name: Wärtsilä Oyj Abp (Wärtsilä Corporation)
summary: Wärtsilä is a Finnish marine and energy technology group (founded 1834) supplying ship engines and propulsion, engine power plants for grid balancing, lifecycle services, and — through its Energy Storage & Optimisation business — utility-scale BESS (Quantum series) and the GEMS Digital Energy Platform. The storage business's ownership has moved in two stages: an 18-month strategic review concluded in March 2025 with retention (elevated to a standalone segment), but on 15 June 2026 Wärtsilä announced it will fold global Energy Storage into a 50/50 joint venture with Germany's RCT Solutions GmbH (RCT CEO Peter Fath to lead the JV; closing expected Q3 2026), reclassifying it as discontinued operations.
ecosystemRole: One of the established Western storage integrators: >19 GWh deployed or contracted across 130+ sites worldwide (company-reported), a global top-ten placement in Wood Mackenzie's inaugural BESS integrator ranking (July 2026), and an early leader in storage cybersecurity (first-in-industry IEC 62443 certification for GEMS technology). The 2025 numbers show the strategic squeeze: segment order intake fell 60% to EUR 455M (2,677 MWh, -52%) on US tariffs, FEOC rules, and price competition — the backdrop to the JV decision.

productsAndServices.name: GridSolve Quantum3 BESS (flagship AC block, September 2024)
productsAndServices.description: 5 MWh high-density AC block in a 20-ft ISO container with fully integrated batteries and string-based PCS enabling decentralised, rack-level control; aluminum housing with single-side access and back-to-back siting; US-engineered proprietary BMS; low-GWP cooling with low noise. Fire safety marketed as 'exceeding current global regulations' plus industry-leading cybersecurity — the flagship of the GridSolve BESS family, powered by GEMS.
highlights: Deliberately balances energy density against weight — Wärtsilä argues the very densest 20-ft blocks risk exceeding road-weight limits and adding shipping cost (VP Andy Tang, via Energy-Storage.News)
String-based PCS integrated in the block — a failed string derates rather than trips the whole container
Marketed on delivery record: 19+ GWh delivered or contracted across 130+ sites worldwide
productsAndServices.positioning: Sits in the grid-scale '5 MWh in a 20-ft container' class that Tesla, Sungrow, CATL, BYD and EVLO-class products define (Energy-Storage.News grouped its launch with EVLO's contemporaneous 5 MWh product). Wood Mackenzie's July 2026 inaugural global BESS integrator ranking places Wärtsilä in the global top ten and frames it — with Fluence and Powin — as a 'pure-play' integrator competing against vertically integrated Sungrow (#1), Tesla (#2), CATL (#3) and BYD (#4) on system design, commissioning expertise, safety architecture and controls software rather than in-house cell/PCS manufacturing.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct equipment-plus-integration delivery to utilities, IPPs and storage developers, bundled with GEMS software and Service+ lifecycle agreements
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Utility-scale storage owners (utilities, IPPs, renewables developers) in North America, Europe, Australia, Taiwan and Chile; grid-support and data-centre-adjacent applications
productsAndServices.roadmap: The entire Energy Storage business — Quantum hardware, GEMS and lifecycle services — is slated to transfer into the 50/50 JV with RCT Solutions GmbH (announced 15 June 2026; closing expected Q3 2026, subject to approvals and financing)

productsAndServices.name: GridSolve Quantum2 BESS (DC block, March 2024)
productsAndServices.description: Pre-installed 4 MWh DC-block BESS in a CSC/ISO 20-ft enclosure for 2–8-hour applications, with IP67 liquid-cooled modules, integrated DC connections, scalable building blocks, and a configurable hybrid cooling system engineered for rapid deployment.
highlights: Compliant with UL 9540A, NFPA 855, and IEC 62443-4 per its solution sheet
Selected February 2026 for Gramme Storage 1 (Belgium, 50 MW / 100 MWh grid-stability project) with GEMS; completion expected Q2 2027
productsAndServices.positioning: The DC-block option in the GridSolve range — for projects where the developer wants Wärtsilä's enclosure/BMS/controls but a separate PCS topology, and for 2–8-hour energy-shifting durations
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Same channel as Quantum3: direct to utilities/IPPs/developers with GEMS and lifecycle services attached
productsAndServices.targetSegments: European and global grid-stability and energy-shifting projects in the 2–8-hour duration band
productsAndServices.roadmap: Transfers to the RCT Solutions JV with the rest of the storage portfolio (closing expected Q3 2026)

productsAndServices.name: GridSolve Quantum High Energy (high-density enclosure, November 2023)
productsAndServices.description: High-energy-density BESS enclosure built on 306 Ah lithium-ion cells — 9% higher energy density than the prior generation, cutting land requirements by up to 15% and the unit count per site. Safety architecture: active dehumidification, prefabricated fire walls between units, centrally located dual sprinkler systems, gas-detection ports for external sampling, and external door latches for first-responder access.
highlights: Hardware behind EnergyAustralia's 1,400 MWh Wooreen BESS (Victoria, Australia) — all 1,038 Quantum High Energy units delivered and installed

Hardware behind the 150 MW / 300 MWh Bungama BESS for Revera Energy (South Australia), operational 30 June 2026 — Wärtsilä's fourth operational Australian storage project and stage one of a multi-stage site
Wärtsilä claims a 100% fire-safety record across the GridSolve Quantum fleet
GEMS integration supports black start, island operation, and virtual-synchronous-generator functions
productsAndServices.positioning: The volume workhorse for multi-hundred-MWh energy-shifting projects — pitched on fleet safety record and land/BOS savings rather than headline container density
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct to utilities and storage owner-operators as part of integrated GridSolve deliveries
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Large energy-shifting and capacity projects in high-renewables grids (Australia's NEM is the showcase market)
productsAndServices.roadmap: Transfers to the RCT Solutions JV (closing expected Q3 2026)

productsAndServices.name: GEMS Digital Energy Platform (incl. GEMS Pulse & GEMS Cloud Connect)
productsAndServices.description: Energy-management and optimisation software monitoring, controlling, and optimising storage and hybrid assets from battery cell to fleet level; the 7th generation (August 2024) added autonomous, sub-second control of multi-GWh sites. GEMS Pulse (October 2025) layers predictive cell-to-fleet analytics on top — real-time state-of-health, state-of-charge, cell-imbalance and usable-energy estimation, anomaly detection and scenario tools, fed by over a million data points per second across 9+ GWh of operational storage. GEMS Cloud Connect (formerly GEMS Fleet Director) is the cloud suite for fleet-level value optimisation.
highlights: Operated on 100+ projects across Australia, North America, Europe, Taiwan, and Chile
First-in-industry IEC 62443 cybersecurity certification for GEMS technology; GEMS Cloud Connect achieved SOC 2 Type 1 compliance February 2026 (audit with Insight Assurance), Type 2 audit in progress
GEMS Pulse won the CleanTech Analytics Innovation Award in the 2026 CleanTech Breakthrough Awards (April 2026)
Analytics kept in-house — built on Wärtsilä's own fleet data and battery-science labs rather than third-party battery-analytics vendors (Energy-Storage.News)
productsAndServices.positioning: The software-and-controls layer is Wärtsilä's core differentiation argument as a pure-play integrator against hardware-led, vertically integrated rivals (Sungrow, Tesla, CATL, BYD) — sold on optimisation revenue uplift, cybersecurity certification depth, and multi-asset (storage + engine + renewables) coordination that single-product vendors lack
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Bundled with GridSolve deliveries and as the control layer for hybrid fleets; ongoing software/analytics subscriptions via lifecycle agreements
productsAndServices.targetSegments: BESS asset owners and operators, hybrid (engine + storage + renewable) plant operators, and data-centre power installations
productsAndServices.roadmap: SOC 2 Type 2 attestation in progress; platform transfers to the RCT Solutions JV with the storage business (closing expected Q3 2026)

productsAndServices.name: Energy storage lifecycle services (Service+)
productsAndServices.description: Suite of BESS lifecycle services across three tiers: Base (remote operational support and GEMS maintenance via an Agreement Manager and the Wärtsilä Expertise Centre), Prime (adds system maintenance at planned cost), and GAP — Guaranteed Asset Performance (maintenance with performance guarantees across the system's operating life). 24/7 remote operational support, performance guarantees, extended warranties and augmentation support de-risk financing and operation.
highlights: Energy Storage service net sales EUR 23M in 2025 (+52%) on the growing installed base — the recurring-revenue layer on 19+ GWh delivered or contracted
productsAndServices.positioning: Guarantee-backed lifecycle coverage is pitched as the pure-play integrator's answer to vertically integrated rivals' balance sheets — locking in long-duration service annuities on the delivered fleet
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Long-term service agreements attached to delivered systems
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Owners and operators of the delivered GridSolve/GEMS fleet (130+ sites worldwide)
productsAndServices.roadmap: Lifecycle support transfers to the RCT Solutions JV with the rest of the storage business

productsAndServices.name: Engine power plants (Wärtsilä Energy — balancing & flexible baseload; retained, NOT in the storage JV)
productsAndServices.description: Medium-speed 4-stroke engine plants built from 6–23 MW generating sets scaling past 450 MW per plant — the complementary flexibility product to storage: engines carry long-duration, firm and island loads that batteries cannot. Lineup: Wärtsilä 31SG (10.8–12.4 MW, up to 52.1% electrical efficiency), 46TS-SG/DF (20.4–22.9 MW, 51.3%/50.7%, 2-minute start), 50SG/50DF (18.4/17.6 MW, 30-second grid connection), plus 34SG/32 mid-bore units. Marketed for renewables balancing, peaking, off-grid/bridging primary power for data centres (bypassing multi-year grid-interconnection queues), and CHP.
highlights: FY2025 Energy order intake EUR 2,940M (+31%) with 2,324 MW ordered (+69%), including Wärtsilä's first two US data-centre power projects totalling 789 MW
Q1 2026: 24 × Wärtsilä 50SG (429 MW) ordered by a US investor-owned utility for data-centre demand; commercial operation late 2028–early 2029
Claimed 20–35% lower fuel consumption than gas turbines, large plants operational in 12 months, full output from −45°C to +50°C, water use under 5 litres/hour
Pure DC Ireland: Europe's first off-grid data-centre microgrid, powered by Wärtsilä engines
productsAndServices.positioning: Positioned against gas turbines on part-load efficiency, 2-minute/30-second start times, modular N+1 redundancy and near-zero water use — and alongside its own BESS line as the 'engines + storage + GEMS' hybrid pitch for data centres and high-renewables grids; this business (with its EUR 8.9B+ group order book) is what Wärtsilä keeps after divesting storage
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct EPC/equipment delivery to utilities, IPPs, industrial and island-grid customers — increasingly US utilities serving data-centre load — with O&M and long-term service agreements
productsAndServices.targetSegments: Utilities and IPPs in high-renewables grids, island and off-grid systems, US data-centre-driven capacity buyers
productsAndServices.roadmap: Fuel-flexibility path to net zero: 100% hydrogen-ready 31SG-H2 (runs natural gas with up to 25 vol-% hydrogen blends before conversion) and pure-hydrogen 31H2 launched June 2024, tendering 2025 with deliveries from 2026; world-first large-scale 100%-hydrogen engine running on Spain's grid at Bermeo demonstrated to customers June 2026; conversion packages for hydrogen with ammonia and methanol conversion capability to follow (ammonia and methanol engines already launched on the marine side)

productsAndServices.name: Services & marine (context)
productsAndServices.description: Group service net sales EUR 3,575M in 2025 — lifecycle solutions up to guaranteed-performance O&M agreements across the engine fleet. Marine (engines, propulsion, services) remains the group's largest segment at EUR 3,494M FY2025 net sales.

recentDevelopments.headline: Wood Mackenzie's inaugural global BESS integrator ranking places Wärtsilä in the global top ten (Sungrow #1, Tesla #2, CATL #3)
recentDevelopments.read: Independent validation of integrator relevance even as the market tops 100 GW/yr and Chinese vertically integrated players dominate — Wärtsilä is bucketed with Fluence and Powin as a 'pure-play' integrator.

recentDevelopments.headline: 150 MW / 300 MWh Bungama BESS (Revera Energy, South Australia) reaches commercial operation — fourth operational Australian storage project
recentDevelopments.read: Quantum High Energy + GEMS delivering in the showcase NEM market; stage one of a multi-stage site keeps follow-on capacity in view for the JV's order book.

recentDevelopments.headline: 50/50 JV with RCT Solutions GmbH announced for the global Energy Storage business; storage reclassified as discontinued operations
recentDevelopments.read: The whole product stack researched here — Quantum, GEMS, lifecycle services, ~480 staff, EUR 719M order book — moves to a JV led by RCT's Peter Fath; closing expected Q3 2026, so the sales counterpart may soon be the JV, not Wärtsilä.

recentDevelopments.headline: GEMS Pulse wins the 'CleanTech Analytics Innovation Award' in the 2026 CleanTech Breakthrough Awards
recentDevelopments.read: Third-party recognition for the analytics layer six months after launch — supports the software-differentiation pitch during JV transition uncertainty.

recentDevelopments.headline: GEMS Cloud Connect (ex-Fleet Director) achieves SOC 2 Type 1 compliance; Type 2 audit underway
recentDevelopments.read: Extends the cybersecurity-first positioning (IEC 62443 heritage) into enterprise cloud attestation — a procurement checkbox utilities and data-centre customers increasingly require.

recentDevelopments.headline: Construction starts on 50 MW / 100 MWh Gramme Storage 1 BESS in Belgium (Quantum2 + GEMS); completion expected Q2 2027
recentDevelopments.read: Keeps European grid-stability deliveries flowing through the JV transition — and shows Quantum2 DC blocks still winning alongside the newer Quantum3.

recentDevelopments.headline: 24 × Wärtsilä 50SG engines (429 MW) ordered for a US power plant serving data-centre demand; COD late 2028–early 2029
recentDevelopments.read: The retained engine business is monetising the US data-centre power squeeze — Q1 2026 booking on top of 2025's first two US data-centre projects (789 MW).

recentDevelopments.headline: Wärtsilä to supply a 500 MWh BESS project in Texas (ERCOT)
recentDevelopments.read: US pipeline continuing despite the tariff/FEOC-driven 2025 order collapse — ERCOT remains a core market for the storage business entering the JV.

recentDevelopments.headline: GEMS Pulse launched — predictive cell-to-fleet analytics (SoH, SoC, cell imbalance, usable energy) built in-house on 9+ GWh of fleet data
recentDevelopments.read: Monetises the operational fleet's data exhaust as a revenue-uplift product, and deliberately in-house rather than via third-party battery-analytics vendors.
